pages.title: Quarry
pages.text: $(bold)The stone pickaxe, cobblestone from rocks, the natural stones, the furnace, coal and torches (lit, unlit, burnt and smouldering), the fire starter, and copper ore to smelt into ingots. Needs Woodcutter as well, for the crafting table.$(br2)$(thing)Stone Age$(n), ring 1.$(br)$(thing)5 Focal Shards$(n).$(br)After Core and Woodcutter.
